item.name: trace AWS Lambda handlers with Powertools Tracer
item.summary: Native Node.js preview runs actual Powertools Tracer middleware with a local X-Ray segment. Hosted preview is blocked because Code Mode rejects the secure randomness required to create an actual segment.

manifest.original_contribution: Original, focused Node.js Lambda integration module for AWS X-Ray handler and SDK tracing using the pinned AWS Powertools TypeScript package.

delivery_contract.format: self-contained JSON with exact UTF-8 file contents
delivery_contract.side_effects: The private bounded preview runs only local product behavior and fixtures; buyer deployment may perform AWS service calls as documented.

validation_contract.private_worker_loader_preview: unavailable; X-Ray segment ID secure randomness is rejected in Code Mode global scope

manifest.supported_boundary: A Node.js Lambda helper for Powertools Tracer. Native preview executes actual middleware with a local X-Ray segment fixture; hosted preview cannot create the secure segment ID in Code Mode and remains disabled.
manifest.native_preview_blocker: The Worker Loader executes the private preview in a Code Mode global scope; the actual X-Ray Segment constructor requires crypto.randomBytes to generate its segment ID, which this execution scope rejects.

import AWSXRay from 'aws-xray-sdk-core';

const SLUG = 'lambda-powertools-tracer-ts';

/** Runs Powertools Tracer middleware inside a local synthetic Lambda/X-Ray context. */
export async function preview({ configuration, selected_components } = {}) {
  if (!configuration || configuration.language !== 'javascript'
      || typeof configuration.service_name !== 'string'
      || configuration.capture_response !== false
      || !Array.isArray(selected_components) || selected_components.length !== 1
      || selected_components[0] !== 'base') {
    return { ok: false, status: 'invalid', slug: SLUG, operation_count: 0, diagnostic_codes: ['configuration_invalid'] };
  }
  const envKeys = ['AWS_EXECUTION_ENV', 'AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME', 'AWS_XRAY_TRACING_NAME', '_X_AMZN_TRACE_ID'];
  const originalEnv = Object.fromEntries(envKeys.map(key => [key, process.env[key]]));
  const namespace = AWSXRay.getNamespace();
  const segment = new AWSXRay.Segment('protected-preview');
  try {
    Object.assign(process.env, {
      AWS_EXECUTION_ENV: 'AWS_Lambda_nodejs20.x',
      AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME: 'protected-preview',
      AWS_XRAY_TRACING_NAME: configuration.service_name,
      _X_AMZN_TRACE_ID: 'Root=1-65f00000-0123456789abcdef01234567;Parent=0123456789abcdef;Sampled=1',
    });
    const tracing = createTracing(configuration);
    const request = { event: {}, context: {}, internal: {}, response: { statusCode: 200 } };
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => namespace.run(async () => {
      try {
        tracing.tracer.setSegment(segment);
        await tracing.middleware.before(request);
        await tracing.middleware.after(request);
        if (tracing.tracer.getSegment() !== segment) throw new Error('xray_segment_unavailable');
        resolve();
      } catch (error) { reject(error); }
    }));
    return { ok: true, status: 'valid', slug: SLUG, operation_count: 1,
      diagnostic_codes: ['local_fixture_only'], selected_components };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, status: 'unavailable', slug: SLUG, operation_count: 0, diagnostic_codes: ['runtime_unavailable'] };
  } finally {
    segment.close();
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(originalEnv)) {
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
  }

Use Powertools Tracer to capture a Lambda handler and instrument AWS SDK v3 clients for AWS X-Ray. The helper disables response capture so handler output is not copied into trace metadata by default.

## Install and use

Install the exact direct dependency with `npm install`. Powertools Tracer brings its pinned Commons, AWS Lambda Invoke Store, and AWS X-Ray SDK dependencies. Run on Node.js 20 or newer in Lambda; enable active tracing on the function and grant the Lambda execution role the required X-Ray write actions.

```js
import middy from '@middy/core';
import { DynamoDBClient } from '@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb';
import { createTracing } from './src/tracer.mjs';

const tracing = createTracing({ service_name: 'orders' });
const dynamodb = tracing.captureAwsV3Client(new DynamoDBClient({}));
const handler = middy(async () => {
  // Use dynamodb.send(command) inside the handler.
  return { statusCode: 200 };
}).use(tracing.middleware);
export { handler };
```

The package does not install Middy or an AWS service client for you. Use the service-specific SDK client you already need and pin it in your application lockfile. Do not add secrets, full payloads, or personal data as X-Ray annotations. Tracing is not enabled until Lambda active tracing and IAM are configured.

## Native private preview and boundary

The native Node.js preview runs the actual Powertools Tracer middleware with a real local `aws-xray-sdk-core` Segment in a synthetic Lambda context. It checks local middleware segment context only; it does not send or verify an AWS X-Ray trace. Hosted Worker preview is unavailable: creating an actual X-Ray segment unconditionally requires secure random bytes, which the current Code Mode global execution scope rejects. The package remains native-only and must fail before payment for hosted sandbox preview.

Exact npm package integrity is in `source-provenance.json`.

","mime_type":"application/json","path":"source-provenance.json","sha256":"6ab70a245856cdf477b6dd90a70fb863bbf954bb866b65978e62fcc41fc1ad9f","size_bytes":2034},{"content":"import { Tracer } from '@aws-lambda-powertools/tracer';
import { captureLambdaHandler } from '@aws-lambda-powertools/tracer/middleware';

const SERVICE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$/;

export function createTracing({ service_name } = {}) {
  if (typeof service_name !== 'string' || !SERVICE.test(service_name)) throw new Error('invalid_service_name');
  const tracer = new Tracer({ serviceName: service_name });
  return {
    tracer,
    /** Plug into middy(handler).use(middleware); response capture stays disabled. */
    middleware: captureLambdaHandler(tracer, { captureResponse: false }),
    captureAwsV3Client(client) {
      if (!client || typeof client.send !== 'function') throw new Error('aws_sdk_v3_client_required');
      return tracer.captureAWSv3Client(client);
    },
  };
}
